bugs: Promise/thenable scheduler returns were ignored, so an asynchronous failure could leave composition ending with its queue lease held and retained callbacks still live.
Asynchronous settlement observer rejections were not consumed, unlike synchronous observer exceptions.

failures: Promise, thenable and throwing-then-getter scheduler results incorrectly returned scheduled instead of recoveryRequired.
The observer's rejected promise had no rejection handler installed by the controller.
before.note: Test-owned rejected promises were prehandled to isolate assertions without leaking rejection events during the pre-fix run. Thenable regressions reject when consumed.

fix: Share the existing browser-controller rejection handler with the composition controller and router.
Reject asynchronous scheduler results synchronously and invalidate retained callbacks. Failed recovery scheduling preserves quarantine until explicit recovery or disposal.
Consume observer rejections without awaiting them or changing committed/recovered lifecycle results.

browserIntegration.scenario: composition Unicode commit, Undo and Redo

limits: Custom-hook failure paths are unit-tested. Browser integration covers ordinary simulated composition events, not OS-level IME qualification.
